experience.description:
Key Achievements:
• Engineered a production Generative AI platform in Python and FastAPI using async REST APIs, SSE streaming, and microservices, orchestrating LangGraph Member and Provider agents for autonomous service discovery and booking workflows.
• Developed 15+ custom agent tools letting GPT-4 agents call deterministic backend actions such as geospatial provider search, booking management, PostgreSQL queries, and multi-step API workflows, backed by typed Pydantic contracts and OpenAPI documentation.
• Adopted AI-assisted development workflows to accelerate Python development, repository analysis, debugging, refactoring, test creation, and code review; built Model Context Protocol (MCP) tool and context integrations to extend those workflows.
• Built context-injection and prompt-engineering logic personalizing LLM prompts by location, role, and session state, improving relevance and routing accuracy across the agent graph; containerized services with Docker and shipped through CI/CD.

Key Achievements:
• Built and optimized Django backend hiring platform serving 150 concurrent users, improving page load speed by 50% through SQL query optimization, session management, and database tuning.
• Integrated a resume parser automating screening of 250+ resumes/month at 92% field-extraction accuracy, reducing manual HR verification time.
• Designed a dual-agent Generative AI interview bot using Groq, LangChain, PostgreSQL, and Pinecone, achieving sub-200ms context retrieval through hybrid storage and vector search.
• Deployed an automated attendance module for 150 employees, reducing data-entry errors by 80%.

Key Achievements:
• Built Python and FastAPI internal tooling and REST endpoints that automated recurring security assessment workflows, replacing manual checks and cutting report turnaround time.
• Developed Python automation scripts for vulnerability scanning, log parsing, and evidence collection, consolidating output from multiple tools into a single structured reporting pipeline.
• Performed vulnerability assessment and penetration testing across web applications, documenting OWASP Top 10 findings with reproducible steps and remediation guidance for development teams.
• Applied secure coding practices such as input validation, authentication and authorization checks, and dependency review, which now carry into API design and LLM application work.
